title: Real Scale
description: Scales mobs to be closer to their real scale.
body:
**Scales mobs to be closer to their real scale.**

This mod makes the game harder in lots of ways, mostly by rescaling **spiders** and **silverfish**. But the mod also rescales lots of other mobs like Bees, Cave Spiders, Frogs, Bats, Tadpoles, Dolphins, Horses, Chickens, Wolves, Ocelots, Endermen, Iron Golems, Creepers and Ghasts.
